spanish: Y harás el altar maderas de shitím; cinco codos largo y cinco codos ancho; cuadrado será el altar, y tres codos su alto.

findings.issue: שִׁטִּים is a common noun left as the untranslated transliteration shitím; common nouns stay Spanish.

notes: Make, the altar (twice), wood, five/five/three cubits, length, width, squared, will-be, and its height match the tokens.
